result.title: LAGO: Language Agents with Reusable Growing Options
result.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. Equal contribution: Yuran Wu, Mengkang Hu. Corresponding author: Xu Wang
result.summary: Long-horizon tasks expose a weakness of monolithic tool-use loops: one agent must decompose, execute, and verify a task within a single trajectory. We introduce LAGO, which treats specialized language agents as reusable temporally extended options. A meta-agent retrieves options from a persistent library or spawns new ones, dispatches sub-tasks, verifies results, and admits successful novel options. The library grows across tasks without updating model weights. On 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, frozen Qwen3.5-35B-A3B in both roles resolves 58.6% under single-attempt evaluation with the official Docker evaluator. On a fixed 150-task subset, we re-run mini-SWE-agent, Terminus 2, and LAGO with the same policy, temperature, task IDs, and evaluator; their resolve rates are 49.3%, 57.3%, and 60.3%, respectively. Cross-model experiments provide evidence consistent with a role for decomposition quality. A 50-task component ablation finds four fewer resolved tasks without decomposition, two fewer with shuffled reused content, and six fewer without the library. These results support reusable agent-options as a practical abstraction for task streams, while leaving component-level causality task- and model-dependent.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LAGO，把专用语言 agent 当作可复用的时序扩展选项，由 meta-agent 从持久选项库检索或新建选项、分派子任务并验证结果，在 SWE-bench Verified 上以冻结模型验证其解决率提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身面向软件工程长程任务、不涉及视觉状态，但其「可复用选项库＋meta-agent 调度与验证准入」可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 调度与可复用推理子策略的组织方式，属推测性迁移线索。
